Don’t be left out in the cold this winter – make sure your truck is properly heated with a Volvo Blower Motor. It installs easily and quickly into your dashboard vents and can be set to either push out hot air or cool air depending on the climate system settings and your fan speed selection. Adjusting the fan speed sends a signal through a resistor to either pick up the pace or slow it down, so you can always maintain the perfect temperature inside your truck.

A gasket designed specifically for Volvo D11s, D13s & D16 engines (OE equivalent part numbers 85151109; 20744939; 85109694 & 85124623). The water pump gasket is an integral component the engine’s cooling system. If the seal becomes compromised, it could lead to serious damage from coolant leaks and overheating; thus, a timely replacement must be made if signs of leakage present themselves. Poor installation or long periods without use can make these seals susceptible to failure due to corrosion in the cooler fluid.
